## Description

Constructs dynamic asset allocation weights by minimizing worst-case Conditional Value-at-Risk (CVaR) over a Wasserstein ambiguity set around historical return distributions.

## Where it may fit

High parameter uncertainty, severe market stress, tail-risk mitigation during macro shocks.

## Vehicles

Tail-Risk Hedge Funds, Institutional Pension Portfolios, Risk-Parity Funds.

## Required data

Historical asset return vectors, Wasserstein ambiguity radius parameters, confidence thresholds.

## Caveats

Convex optimization reformulations scale with asset dimension and require efficient conic solvers.
